notes.title: Official Version 1 Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

After so many updates I am happy to announce the official version 1 (stable) of the game. I did a battery of tests with our QA and came to solve all the issues we could find. Here is the list of fixes:


 Fixed the weird behavior of the 3rd boss Demeb while trying to beat her again
 Fixed some Colorchemy Laboratories not being re-playable
 Fixed a bug when you die after entering a bonus on level 4-1
 Fixed the dialog skipping bug (constant fading)
 Fixed a bug with the achievements The Alchemist and Untouchable (sometimes the deaths were not properly counted)


The game is not over! Soon I hope to release a bunch of new content like new mounts, new artworks and small changes on the world map screen. Stay tuned! :)

notes.title: Huge list of bug fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Last week we did a QA session with the game and found many issues. Sorry about that! Today we are releasing the first pack of bug fixes of the following:


 Blocked the view of the source code on pressing F12
 Fixed the visual bug on trying to skip the dialogs multiple times in a short amount of time
 Colorchemy Labs (all): fixed the potions being overlapped
 Colorchemy Lab 1: fixed the potions not spinning after a death
 Colorchemy Lab 2: fixed the potions that could be destroyed without the use of the spinning tool in the center of the screen Level 2-3: fixed the first Smoker that could stuck the character
 Level 2-3: fixed the character being transported to the beginning of level after completing the second bonus
 Level 3-1: fixed the player still moving on the rope while pausing the game
 Level 3-2: fixed the wagon (cart) being slowed down upon pressing the action button
 Level 4-1: fixed the lava not stopping rising when the player enters the bonus
 Level 4-1: fixed the lava going all way to the beginning of the level after leaving the bonus
 Word 4: fixed the volcano smoke not being present on the bonus levels


Soon a second patch will be published! Have fun!

notes.title: Bugfixes + level progress display
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

In the last May 27th Heart of Smoke was played during a live by the Brazilian channel Inside The Gamer Brazil. You can watch it below:

[previewyoutube=taFMVkFlxZ8;full][/previewyoutube]

During that live some bugs were found and this update fixes all of them:


 Changed "space" key to any key on title screen to start the game (this caused some confusion)
 Fixed all the accents and text being cut for portuguese translations
 Fixed the character always get moved to the start of the world map after the first puzzle
 Fixed the hot air balloon being stuck on the temples of level 2
 Fixed the endless mount (Smokler) time after entering the bonus on level 2
 Fixed not being able to leave the game using the pause menu
 Fixed the "moonwalking" Mongold on level 1


Not only that, but we also included the level progress in % during the world maps. You can now check how much you still have to complete each stage.

Have fun!
